node.title: Re^3: wrap abbreviations in XML element
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As you will see, the separating whitespace is repeated after the "abbrev" element.

Yes, that's because of the behavior of [doc://split] when there are multiple capturing groups present in the regular expression, that's why I wrote "don't include any capturing parens in this!". So if you change the capturing group in your regular expression into a non-capturing group, it'll work as expected: qr/a\.(?:!!!emsp14;|!!!hairsp;)A\./ See also [doc://perlretut].
